pages.text: Genetic froglights are colored lights made with $(l:zen_amphibia:resources/frog_slime)Frog Slime$(/l), Glowstone Dust, Magma Cream, and dye. This gives frog keepers an Overworld-friendly route into frog-themed lighting.

pages.title: The Wild Route
pages.text: A genetic frog that eats a small magma cube drops a $(b)genetic froglight$() whose color matches its genome — not a vanilla froglight. The color is shaped by three genes: $(b)Coloration$() (red channel), $(b)Heat Tolerance$() (green channel), and $(b)Humidity Tolerance$() (blue channel). Breeding frogs for specific combinations is how you target a particular light color.

pages.title: Color Palette
pages.text: The dominant gene channel determines the froglight color. $(b)Verdant:$() green dominant. $(b)Azure:$() blue dominant (cool). $(b)Violet:$() blue dominant with red influence. $(b)Rose:$() red dominant (cool). $(b)Amber:$() red dominant with green warmth. $(b)Pearl:$() all channels balanced and bright. $(b)Umbral:$() all channels balanced and dim.
